description: Tig is an ncurses-based text-mode interface for git(1).
It functions mainly as a Git repository browser, but can also assist in staging changes for commit at chunk level and act as a pager for output from various Git commands.

next.name: blame
tip: Show given file annotated by commits.
Takes zero or more git-blame(1) options. Optionally limited from given revision.

next.name: grep
tip: Open the grep view.
Supports the same options as git-grep(1).

next.name: log
tip: Start up in log view, displaying git-log(1) output.

next.name: reflog
tip: Start up in reflog view.

next.name: refs
tip: Start up in refs view.
All refs are displayed unless limited by one of --branches, --remotes, or --tags.

option.name: --branches
tip: Limit the displayed refs to local branches.

option.name: --remotes
tip: Limit the displayed refs to remote-tracking branches.

option.name: --tags
tip: Limit the displayed refs to tags.

next.name: show
tip: Open diff view using the given git-show(1) options.

next.name: stash
tip: Start up in stash view.

next.name: status
tip: Start up in status view.

option.name: --help
tip: Show help message and exit.

option.name: --version
tip: Show version and exit.

option.name: -C
tip: Run as if Tig was started in <path> instead of the current working directory.
Select line <number> in the first view.

global_option.name: --all
tip: All the refs in refs/ are listed on the command line as if they were given.
Implies --no-revs.

global_option.name: --ancestry-path
tip: Only show commits that lie between two commits on an ancestry path.
The set of commits are limited to those which are descendants of the older one and ancestors of the newer one.

global_option.name: --author-date-order
tip: Process commits in order of their author timestamp.
A commit is older than another if its author timestamp is earlier, and the timestamp is used to break ties.

global_option.name: --before
tip: Show commits older than a specific date.

global_option.name: --boundary
tip: Show the boundary commits that were always excluded from the log.

global_option.name: --cached
tip: Diff against the index rather than the working tree.

global_option.name: --cherry
tip: When comparing two branches, show only commits that have not been applied to the other branch.

global_option.name: --cherry-pick
tip: Like --cherry, but always show the full commit.

global_option.name: --date-order
tip: Process commits in order of committer timestamp.
Otherwise commits are processed in topological order.

global_option.name: --diff-filter
tip: Limit the diff output to one of the following types: Added, Copied, Deleted, Modified, Renamed, Type-changed, Unmerged, or Broken.

global_option.name: --diff-merges
tip: Output the diff for merge commits and their parents.
Alias for first-parent.

next.name: combined
tip: Do a combined diff.

next.name: dense-combined
tip: Like combined, but omit unrelated changes.

next.name: first-parent
tip: Print diff against the first parent only.

next.name: off
tip: Do not output any diff info at all.

next.name: on
tip: Print the combined diff as normal.

next.name: remerge
tip: Automatically re-merge parents and show a real diff.

next.name: separate
tip: Print separate diffs for each parent.

global_option.name: --first-parent
tip: Only follow the first parent commit upon seeing a merge commit.

global_option.name: --follow
tip: Show changes which affect the specified paths, even when they happen on a file rename.

global_option.name: --format
tip: Format to be used for each commit subject line.

global_option.name: --full-history
tip: Show history for the given paths, including all commits with tree changes, not just those that change the given paths.

global_option.name: --full-index
tip: Instead of the first handful of characters, show the full pre- and post-image blob object names.

global_option.name: --graph
tip: Draw a text-based graphical representation of the commit history on the left hand side of the output.

global_option.name: --grep
tip: Show only commits that have the <PATTERN> in the commit message.
Note that this is a separate filter applied after --author, --since and other filters.

global_option.name: --ignore-all-space
tip: Ignore all whitespace when comparing lines.

global_option.name: --ignore-space-at-eol
tip: Ignore changes in whitespace at the end of lines.

global_option.name: --ignore-space-change
tip: Ignore changes in amount of whitespace.

global_option.name: --indent-heuristic
tip: Turn on diff.indent-heuristic even when diff.indent-heuristic in the config is false.

global_option.name: --max-count
tip: Limit the number of commits to output.

global_option.name: --max-parents
tip: Do not show commits with more than <N> parents.

global_option.name: --merges
tip: Only show merge commits.

global_option.name: --name-only
tip: Show only the names of files changed in each commit.

global_option.name: --name-status
tip: Show only the names of files changed in each commit, with the change kind.
The change kind is a letter identifying the modification: Added, Copied, Deleted, Modified, Renamed, or Type-changed.

global_option.name: --no-merges
tip: Do not show commits that have more than one parent.

global_option.name: --no-notes
tip: Do not show the notes attached to a commit.

global_option.name: --no-patch
tip: Suppress the diff part of the output, leaving only the message part.

global_option.name: --notes
tip: Show the notes attached to a commit.
When <ref> is omitted, the notes of the default ref are shown.

global_option.name: --numstat
tip: Similar to --name-only, but shows number of added and deleted lines in numeric form.

global_option.name: --oneline
tip: This is a shorthand for --pretty=oneline --abbrev-commit used together.

global_option.name: --output
tip: Write to <FILE> instead of stdout.

global_option.name: --patch
tip: Show patch diffs.

global_option.name: --pretty
tip: Pretty print each commit message in the given <FORMAT>.

next.name: default
tip: Alias for the full format.

next.name: email
tip: Similar to the full format, but add a From: header line.

next.name: full
tip: Like the default format.

next.name: mbox
tip: Like email, but only if the commit has a From: header line.

next.name: oneline
tip: The subject and the abbreviated commit id, on a single line.

next.name: raw
tip: Show the entire commit as given by the git log format.

next.name: reference
tip: Like the default format, but indent the subject line.

next.name: short
tip: The commit id, the author name and date, and the subject.

global_option.name: --reverse
tip: Output the commits selected to be shown in reverse order.

global_option.name: --root
tip: When --root is specified the initial commit will always be shown in the output.

global_option.name: --show-notes
tip: Attach the notes for each commit to the output.

global_option.name: --simplify-merges
tip: Show commits that change the number of parents, such as merges and introductions of branches.

global_option.name: --since
tip: Show commits more recent than a specific date.
Must be specified with --pretty format to be interpreted correctly.

global_option.name: --stat
tip: Show a diffstat at the end of the output.

global_option.name: --stdin
tip: Read the list of commits from stdin instead of treating them as command line arguments.

global_option.name: --submodule
tip: Changes in submodules are shown according to the given mode.

next.name: diff
tip: The diff contents of the submodule.

next.name: log
tip: A diff log between the two commits in the submodule.

next.name: none
tip: Changes in submodules are never shown.

next.name: short
tip: Only the short SHA-1 of the commit(s) in the submodule.

global_option.name: --topo-order
tip: Do not show a commit until all of its descendants have been shown.

global_option.name: --unified
tip: Generate diffs with <N> lines of context instead of the usual three.

global_option.name: --walk-reflogs
tip: Follow the reflog of the current branch. Incompatible with --max-count.

global_option.name: --word-diff
tip: Show the word-level diff within the file-level diff.

next.name: color
tip: Like plain, but with colors.

next.name: plain
tip: Print removed and added words without any decoration.

next.name: porcelain
tip: Machine readable output intended for scripts.

global_option.name: --word-diff-regex
tip: Use <REGEX> to decide what a non-space word is, instead of considering runs of non-whitespace to be a word.

global_option.name: -G
tip: Show only diffs that change the number of occurrences of the regex <REGEX>.

global_option.name: -S
tip: Show only diffs that change the number of occurrences of the specified <STRING>.
